# LanLance's Blog

> LanLance.cn - Code is Cheap. Personal technical blog covering Go microservices, CloudWeGo (Hertz/Kitex/Netpoll), high-concurrency backend architecture, and AI coding workflows, alongside reading notes and annual reviews.

## Sections

- [Posts](https://lanlance.cn/posts/): Technical articles on Go, CloudWeGo, distributed systems, and AI engineering.
- [Books](https://lanlance.cn/books/): Reading notes and book reviews.
- [Annual Reviews](https://lanlance.cn/annual/): Yearly reflections from 2022 to 2025.
- [Categories](https://lanlance.cn/categories/): Articles grouped by topic category.
- [Tags](https://lanlance.cn/tags/): Articles grouped by tag.
- [About](https://lanlance.cn/about/): Background, open-source contributions, and work experience.
- [Atom Feed](https://lanlance.cn/atom.xml): Latest 20 entries in Atom XML format.

## Featured Posts

- [Harness 和 LLM 的动态博弈](https://lanlance.cn/posts/harness-llm-dynamic-game/): Evolution of agent tool orchestration and why Harness boundaries shift with stronger models.
- [半年后的今天，我怎么用 AI 写代码](https://lanlance.cn/posts/ai-coding-now/): Practical AI coding stack, SOP, and Ensemble Review workflow.
- [读懂 Warp 的 Agent Skill 自进化机制](https://lanlance.cn/posts/warp-agent-skills/): Self-evolving Base + Improver skill loop driven by human feedback.
- [别让 LLM 当 JSON 搬运工](https://lanlance.cn/posts/llm-json-mover/): Cloudflare Code Mode and Everything-CLI design philosophy.
- [C 端高并发下的 KV 存储优化](https://lanlance.cn/posts/kv-storage-optimization/): Solving large-value KV bottlenecks using Apache Fory and Zstd.

## Usage

- Content negotiation: send `Accept: text/markdown` to any post URL to receive clean Markdown.
- AI crawlers and agents are permitted to index, cite, and use content from this site.
